title: [YSQL] Explain Analyze Forces Distributed Transaction
body:
Jira Link: [DB-8384](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-8384)
### Description

Consider an RF-3 cluster with nodes spread across multiple regions, and with preferred leaders in us-west. Create a table with the following schema:
```
CREATE TABLE orders_int(
    id serial PRIMARY KEY,
    total decimal(12, 2),
    products VARCHAR(255)
);

10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# \d orders_int
                     Table "public.orders_int"
  Column  |          Type          | Collation | Nullable | Default
----------+------------------------+-----------+----------+---------
 id       | integer                |           | not null |
 total    | numeric(12,2)          |           |          |
 products | character varying(255) |           |          |
Indexes:
    "orders_int_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, lsm (id HASH)
```

Insert a few rows into the table in a single, stable connection, note down the timings:
```
10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# INSERT INTO orders_int2 (total, products) VALUES (1.0, 'test');
INSERT 0 1
Time: 77.826 ms
10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# INSERT INTO orders_int2 (total, products) VALUES (1.0, 'test');
INSERT 0 1
Time: 75.649 ms
10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# INSERT INTO orders_int2 (total, products) VALUES (1.0, 'test');
INSERT 0 1
Time: 82.754 ms
10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# INSERT INTO orders_int2 (total, products) VALUES (1.0, 'test');
INSERT 0 1
Time: 75.009 ms
10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# INSERT INTO orders_int2 (total, products) VALUES (1.0, 'test');
INSERT 0 1
Time: 71.869 ms
```

Repeat the same experiment with `EXPLAIN ANALYZE INSERT ...`:
```
10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# EXPLAIN ANALYZE INSERT INTO orders_int2 (total, products) VALUES (1.0, 'test');
<snip>
Time: 133.137 ms

10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# EXPLAIN ANALYZE INSERT INTO orders_int2 (total, products) VALUES (1.0, 'test');
<snip>
Time: 122.442 ms

10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# EXPLAIN ANALYZE INSERT INTO orders_int2 (total, products) VALUES (1.0, 'test');
<snip>
Time: 115.006 ms

10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# EXPLAIN ANALYZE INSERT INTO orders_int2 (total, products) VALUES (1.0, 'test');
<snip>
Time: 121.626 ms

10.150.0.16 yugabyte@yugabyte=# EXPLAIN ANALYZE INSERT INTO orders_int2 (total, products) VALUES (1.0, 'test');
<snip>
Time: 118.401 ms
```

We notice the following with respect to `EXPLAIN ANALYZE INSERT ...`:
1. The average latency is higher by an amount that is approx 1 round trip between us-west (preferred leader) and the closest region to it (us-central in the above example)
2. There is higher variance in the latency numbers.

**Symptom**:
In multi-region clusters, `EXPLAIN ANALZE INSERT ...`  are 1 round-trip time slower than vanilla `INSERTS`.

**Cause**
EXPLAIN statements are treated as utility commands/statements, while vanilla INSERTs are treated as PORTAL_MULTI queries. We have checks to perform the single-row insert optimization in case of the latter:

file: tcop/pquery.c function: ProcessQuery
```
	/* Set whether this is a single-row, single-stmt modify, used in YB mode. */
	queryDesc->estate->yb_es_is_single_row_modify_txn =
		isSingleRowModifyTxn && queryDesc->estate->es_num_result_relations == 1 &&
		(plan->commandType == CMD_UPDATE ||
		 YBCIsSingleRowTxnCapableRel(&queryDesc->estate->es_result_relations[0]));
```

This check for optimization is missing in the corresponding function for utility commands.
This causes `EXPLAIN ANALZE INSERT ...` to be treated as a distributed transaction which then requires a commit flush.
The client ends up waiting for the commit flush, leading to the extra round trip time.
